CE14VialMediumReinforced.description: A reinforced glass vial to hold a medium amount of liquid.

CE14BaseAlchemyBomb.name: alchemical bomb
CE14BaseAlchemyBomb.description: A vial of liquid that explodes with an alchemical reagent cloud when thrown.

CE14GroundTobacco.name: ground tobacco
CE14GroundTobacco.description: Grinded and dried tabac leaves, some like it is a cur.

CE14GroundSage.name: ground sage
CE14GroundSage.description: Ground and dried sage root as it turns out is an excellent substitute for tobacco.

CE14SackFarming.name: sack
CE14SackFarming.description: A bag for various fruits, vegetables, plants and anything else that grows in the bed.

CE14SeedWheat.name: wheat seeds
CE14SeedWheat.description: Small wheat seeds. What will you do with them? Grind them into flour, or plant them again?

CE14SeedPumpkin.name: pumpkin seeds
CE14SeedPumpkin.description: Pumpkin seeds. Some pumpkin seems to have been gutted and butchered.

CE14SeedCucumber.name: cucumber seeds
CE14SeedCucumber.description: Are cucumber seeds. You know what to do with them.

CE14SeedTomato.name: tomato seeds
CE14SeedTomato.description: It looks like powder! They're so small, these seeds.

CE14SeedPepper.name: pepper seeds
CE14SeedPepper.description: Pepper seeds, with a peppercorn inside.

CE14SeedSage.name: sage seeds
CE14SeedSage.description: Sage seeds. It's time to grow some fun herbs!

CE14SeedCotton.name: cotton seeds
CE14SeedCotton.description: Cotton seeds. It's time to grow some pants!

CE14GuardBell.name: guard bell
CE14GuardBell.description: A bell used to set the appropriate alert level.

CE14HerbalBandage.name: herbal bandage
CE14HerbalBandage.description: A bandage net woven from grass, not the most reliable or useful thing, but better than nothing.

CE14Gauze.name: gauze
CE14Gauze.description: Dense cloth gauze, to prevent valuable blood from leaking out of the body.

CE14EnergyCrystalBase.description: A crystal shard capable of storing magical energy.

CE14BaseEssence.name: magic essence
CE14BaseEssence.description: Particles of magical energy polarised into a particular type of magic. Will be gone soon, so try to collect them as soon as possible!

CE14RitualChalk.name: ritual chalk
CE14RitualChalk.description: Quartz chalk, handy for drawing temporary ritual circles.

CE14BaseDemiplaneKey.name: demiplane coordinate key
CE14BaseDemiplaneKey.description: A temporary blob of energy linking the real world and the demiplane. Use it before it dissipates.

CE14Rope.name: rope
CE14Rope.description: Multifunctional rope. You can tie something with it. Or someone.

CE14Scissors.name: scissors
CE14Scissors.description: A tool for shredding wool, hair, clothing, and, if not handled carefully, even fingers.

CE14Screwdriver.name: screwdriver
CE14Screwdriver.description: Industrial grade torque in a small screwdriving package.

CE14BaseSharpeningStone.name: sharpening stone
CE14BaseSharpeningStone.description: Allows you to sharpen blunted weapons. If you overdo it, you may well sharpen the weapon completely.

CE14BaseWallpaper.description: Thin paper wallpaper. You can glue them on the walls from different sides, or peel them off with any sharp object.

CE14MagicShadowStaff.name: magic shadow staff
CE14MagicShadowStaff.description: A long, half-tech, half-magic stick designed to convert magical energy into shadow spells.

CE14ModularIronArrow.name: iron arrow
CE14ModularIronArrow.description: Standard arrow, balance between damage and reliability.

CE14ModularMithrilArrow.name: mithril arrow
CE14ModularMithrilArrow.description: An arrow made of expensive wood and magical iron, you shoot money, but the damage matches.

CE14ModularCopperArrow.name: copper arrow
CE14ModularCopperArrow.description: It's the cheapest and weakest arrow you've ever seen, but it's better than nothing.

CE14ModularIronAxe.name: iron axe
CE14ModularIronAxe.description: A heavy axe for cutting firewood or heads.

CE14ModularIronDagger.name: iron dagger
CE14ModularIronDagger.description: A small, multi-purpose, sharp blade. You can cut meat or throw it at a goblin.

CE14ModularIronDaggerTundra.name: Dagger Tundra
CE14ModularIronDaggerTundra.description: A small, multi-purpose, sharp blade. You can cut meat or throw it at a goblin. It has "tundra" engraved on it.

CE14ModularIronDaggerAgony.name: Dagger Agony
CE14ModularIronDaggerAgony.description: A small, multi-purpose, sharp blade. You can cut meat or throw it at a goblin. It has "agony" engraved on it.

CE14ModularIronHammer.name: iron hammer
CE14ModularIronHammer.description: A small hammer. Good for carpentry work as well as for cracking skulls.

CE14ModularIronHoe.name: iron hoe
CE14ModularIronHoe.description: Hoe. Your perfect tool for tilling the ground and preparing it for gardening.

CE14ModularIronMace.name: iron mace
CE14ModularIronMace.description: A heavy piece of metal on a long stick. What could be simpler than that?

CE14ModularIronPickaxe.name: iron pickaxe
CE14ModularIronPickaxe.description: Notched to perfection, for jamming it into rocks

CE14ModularGuildmasterRapier.name: guildmaster's personal rapier
CE14ModularGuildmasterRapier.description: A personal weapon issued to each guildmaster. Combines reliability and killing power.

CE14ModularIronShovel.name: iron shovel
CE14ModularIronShovel.description: An implement for digging up earth, digging beds or graves.

CE14ModularIronSickle.name: iron sickle
CE14ModularIronSickle.description: Originally developed as a weapon against grass, the sickle suddenly proved itself good at the bloodier harvest as well.

CE14ModularIronSpear.name: iron spear
CE14ModularIronSpear.description: The spear is a weapon whose effectiveness has stood the test of time.

CE14ModularIronKunai.name: iron kunai
CE14ModularIronKunai.description: An effective throwing weapon. Throw it at a wall, or no, better yet, at a goblin!

CE14ModularIronSword.name: iron sword
CE14ModularIronSword.description: the gold standard of edged weapons. Medium length, comfortable grip. No frills.

CE14ModularGuardHalberd.name: guard's halberd
CE14ModularGuardHalberd.description: The standard issue armament of the imperial guard. A long iron halberd adorned with blue feathers and brass

CE14BowCombat.name: combat bow
CE14BowCombat.description: A standard ranged weapon, and even without magic.

CE14BowIceArtifact.name: ice bow
CE14BowIceArtifact.description: A magic bow that needs no ammunition.

CE14BaseLightCrossbow.name: light crossbow
CE14BaseLightCrossbow.description: A small, compact crossbow that is comfortable to hold with one hand. Not too accurate on the reverse side.

CE14CrossboltIron.name: iron crossbow bolt
CE14CrossboltIron.description: Rod with a pointed spike in iron. No plumage, they're not bows.

CE14CrossboltGold.name: gold crossbow bolt
CE14CrossboltGold.description: Rod with a pointed spike in gold. No plumage, they're not bows.

CE14CrossboltCopper.name: copper crossbow bolt
CE14CrossboltCopper.description: Rod with a pointed spike in copper. No plumage, they're not bows.

CE14CrossboltMithril.name: mithril crossbow bolt
CE14CrossboltMithril.description: Rod with a pointed spike in mithril. No plumage, they're not bows.

CE14SpikeWhistle.name: spike
CE14SpikeWhistle.description: Organically spiked with an unknown liquid inside.

CE14DPSMeter.name: DPS Meter
CE14DPSMeter.description: Counts the average damage per second. If you stop hitting it, it shows the result.

CE14RoundLeaver.name: distance fog
CE14RoundLeaver.description: You have reached the edge of the game map. There's nothing further. You can use this fog to get out of the game.

CE14StoneWell.name: well
CE14StoneWell.description: At the bottom of this well gurgles clear water. If you have a bucket, you can reach it.

CE14LaddersDownBase.name: stairway down
CE14LaddersDownBase.description: The dark depths of the underworld are calling you.

CE14LaddersUpBase.name: stairway up
CE14LaddersUpBase.description: A way out of the dark underworld into the overworld.

CE14WallmountFlagAlchemist.name: alchemist tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagAlchemist.description: A tapestry with a potion symbol, indicating that alchemists dwell here.

CE14WallmountFlagBlacksmith.name: blacksmith tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBlacksmith.description: A tapestry with a anvil symbol, indicating that blacksmiths dwell here.

CE14WallmountFlagTavern.name: tavern tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagTavern.description: A tapestry with a beer symbol, indicating that tavern is here.

CE14WallmountFlagBank.name: bank tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBank.description: A tapestry with a coins symbol indicating that this is where the bankers live.

CE14WallmountFlagBankVault.name: bank vault tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBankVault.description: A tapestry with a vault symbol indicating that this is where the bank vaults reside.

CE14WallmountFlagBankCrates.name: bank crates tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBankCrates.description: A tapestry with a crates symbol indicating that this is where the bank vaults reside.

CE14WallmountFlagBankShip.name: bank ship tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBankShip.description: A tapestry with a ship symbol denoting that there is a ship here to trade with the city.

CE14WallmountFlagBankCommandant.name: commandant tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBankCommandant.description: A tapestry with a star symbol indicating that the commandant lives here.

CE14WallmountFlagGuardSwords.name: guard tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagGuardSwords.description: A tapestry with a swords symbol denoting that the guards are here.

CE14WallmountFlagGuardShield.name: guard tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagGuardShield.description: A tapestry with a shield symbol denoting that the guards are here.

CE14WallmountFlagGuardCommander.name: guard commander tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagGuardCommander.description: A tapestry with a star symbol indicating that the Guard Commandant lives here.

CE14WallmountPaintingCandle.name: candle painting
CE14WallmountPaintingCandle.description: A nicely drawn candle in a frame.

CE14WallmountPaintingWoman.name: painting of a woman
CE14WallmountPaintingWoman.description: The painting depicts a woman with a mysterious smile.

CE14WallmountPaintingSaint.name: painting of a saint
CE14WallmountPaintingSaint.description: A drawing of a nun with a halo over her head. This is how you can feel the holiness of the picture.

CE14StatueAngel.name: angel statue
CE14StatueAngel.description: A divine statue of a praying angel.

CE14StatueStoneHeadHigh.name: stone head
CE14StatueStoneHeadHigh.description: Strange stone heads, they seem to be watching.

CE14StatueWizard.name: statue wizard
CE14StatueWizard.description: A statue of a magician holding magic.

CE14BaseTombstone.name: tombstone
CE14BaseTombstone.description: A piece of stone placed in memory of the dead.

CE14BaseFenceBig.name: big fence
CE14BaseFenceBig.description: You definitely need a towel to get to the other side

CE14BaseFenceGateBig.name: fence big gate
CE14BaseFenceGateBig.description: Big man-sized gates. What's your next move?

CE14Cliff.name: cliff
CE14Cliff.description: Severe unevenness of the natural landscape.

CE14BaseFence.name: fence
CE14BaseFence.description: A low fence restricting movement in a purely nominal way.

CE14BaseFenceGate.name: fence gate
CE14BaseFenceGate.description: You have two paths. You can open the door like a normal person, or you can climb over the door like a funny person.

CE14BaseFenceWindow.name: fence window
CE14BaseFenceWindow.description: You can slip an object in here, but you sure as hell can't fit through.

CE14Chasm.name: chasm
CE14Chasm.description: You can't even see the bottom.

CE14FloorLava.name: lava
CE14FloorLava.description: Don't jump in. It's not worth it, no matter how funny it is.

CE14FloorWaterOptimized.name: water
CE14FloorWaterOptimized.description: A trough of plain water. Clean enough for consumption

CE14DemiplaneHint.name: astral crack
CE14DemiplaneHint.description: Those cracks always lead to a way out of the damn place

CE14HighBush.name: high bush
CE14HighBush.description: Very tall and dense thickets. Perhaps someone is watching you from them

CE14BaseRock.name: rock
CE14BaseRock.description: A piece of rock. Hard, heavy, useless.

CE14RoyalPumpkin.name: royal pumpkin
CE14RoyalPumpkin.description: It's a huge pumpkin, it feels like you could even make a carriage out of it.

CE14Snowdrift.name: snowdrift
CE14Snowdrift.description: A big, cold pile of snow.

CE14BaseTree.name: tree
CE14BaseTree.description: Decades of life and growth, saturating the surrounding nature with fresh air.

CE14CrystalBase.name: quartz
CE14CrystalBase.description: Natural quartz crystals that can absorb the magical energy of the world around them.

CE14PlantCabbage.name: cabbage
CE14PlantCabbage.description: You see a cabbage in front of you. Perhaps you were born in one.

CE14PlantCotton.name: cotton
CE14PlantCotton.description: In a way, you're growing future clothes.

CE14PlantCucumber.name: cucumber
CE14PlantCucumber.description: Don't trust people who know how to turn into pickles.

CE14PlantOnion.name: onion
CE14PlantOnion.description: He's so cute it brings tears to my eyes to cut him up.

CE14PlantPepper.name: pepper
CE14PlantPepper.description: Russian roulette. Are you hot, or are you sweet peppers?

CE14PlantPotato.name: potato
CE14PlantPotato.description: Some like to associate themselves with potatoes. People like that are not bad people.

CE14PlantPumpkin.name: pumpkin
CE14PlantPumpkin.description: Legends say there is a pumpkin king who stares into your soul through the crowns of trees.

CE14PlantSage.name: sage
CE14PlantSage.description: Medicinal sage. Some love it for its medicinal properties, others for its narcotic properties. Which side are you on?

CE14PlantTomatoes.name: tomatoes
CE14PlantTomatoes.description: On the one hand, it's a delicious fruit. But why eat it when it's much more fun to use tomatoes as a throwing projectile?

CE14PlantWheat.name: wheat
CE14PlantWheat.description: Most popular crop. Unpretentious, it opens the way to an abundance of flour products.

CE14GatherableBloodFlower.name: blood rose
CE14GatherableBloodFlower.description: Scarlet flowers growing where blood has been spilled.

CE14GatherableBlueAmanita.name: blue Amanita
CE14GatherableBlueAmanita.description: A sky blue flower known for its medicinal and magical properties.

CE14GatherableChromiumSlime.name: chromium slime
CE14GatherableChromiumSlime.description: This rare thick substance can be found in a stream of water as if it has a mind of its own. When trying to change the slime itself - the slime changes the reagent it interacts with.

CE14GatherableDayflin.name: yellow dayflin
CE14GatherableDayflin.description: A yellow sun flower that smells like melted milk. Can be processed into a yellow dye.

CE14GatherableFlyAgaric.name: fly agaric
CE14GatherableFlyAgaric.description: This poisonous mushroom can often be found near bodies of water or other wet areas. It is not recommended for consumption.

CE14GatherableLumiMushroom.name: lumishroom
CE14GatherableLumiMushroom.description: A faintly luminous mushroom. Often used by alchemists as a means of concentrating solutions.

CE14WaterLilies.name: water lilies
CE14WaterLilies.description: Wow, these are plants that don't grow on land, but on water! Nature is amazing.

CE14WaterReeds.name: reed
CE14WaterReeds.description: Usually grows in swamps and on river banks.

CE14GatherableWildSage.name: wild sage
CE14GatherableWildSage.description: Root of this ubiquitous medicinal plant not bad at healing physical injuries, and inducing coughing.

CE14Bonfire.name: bonfire
CE14Bonfire.description: A pile of logs stacked together, ready to burst into flames at the slightest spark.

CE14IronCabinet.name: iron cabinet
CE14IronCabinet.description: an iron cabinet. Sturdy, lockable. You can store your valuables here without fear of some burglar taking it all for himself.

CE14ClosetGlassShowcase.name: glass showcase
CE14ClosetGlassShowcase.description: Something of value can be placed here without fear of it being discreetly stolen!

CE14Lamppost.name: lamppost
CE14Lamppost.description: A lantern hanging from a pole.

CE14LamppostBlue.name: lamppost
CE14LamppostBlue.description: A lantern hanging from a pole.

CE14PottedPlantBase.name: potted plant
CE14PottedPlantBase.description: A domesticated plant in a clay pot, more plants.

CE14TableWooden.name: wooden table
CE14TableWooden.description: A simple table made of boards.

CE14TableWoodenRound.name: round wooden table
CE14TableWoodenRound.description: A simple table made of boards.

CE14BaseTorch.description: A good, reliable light source. Too bad it doesn't last.

CE14WallmountBarShelfA.name: bar shelf
CE14WallmountBarShelfA.description: Wall shelves to store your wine collection

CE14BaseRoof.name: roof
CE14BaseRoof.description: A roof over your head to protect you from the heat of the sun or the weather.

CE14AlchemyFurnace.name: alchemy furnace
CE14AlchemyFurnace.description: A furnace fueled by wood, coal, or any other burning material. Handy for heating your alchemical potions.

CE14BaseSharpeningStoneStructure.name: stationary sharpening stone
CE14BaseSharpeningStoneStructure.description: A strong, durable sharpening stone capable of sharpening weapons without much damage to them.

CE14DemiplanRiftCore.name: demiplan rift core
CE14DemiplanRiftCore.description: A subtle connection between the real world and the demiplane where the adventurers went. Sooner or later they will return from there.

CE14DemiplaneTimedRadiusPassway.name: pulsating demiplane rift
CE14DemiplaneTimedRadiusPassway.description: This rift is gaining strength, and will trap all nearby creatures in a demiplane in a second!

CE14DemiplanePassway.name: demiplane rift
CE14DemiplanePassway.description: A gap in space that allows you to travel between world and demiplanes.

CE14DemiplaneLinkCrystal.name: demiplane link crystal
CE14DemiplaneLinkCrystal.description: Maintains communication with the demiplanes while charged. Causes mosnters from the demiplanes to attack the city. Once it is discharged, the game is over.

CE14PortalFrameCrystal.name: portal frame
CE14PortalFrameCrystal.description: A structure made of shadow crystals used to create a stable portal to another location.

CE14DemiplaneCore.name: demiplane core
CE14DemiplaneCore.description: The heart of the demiplane. Your task is to take it out of the demiplane safe and sound and hand it over to the guildmaster.

CE14CashConverter.name: cash converter
CE14CashConverter.description: A simple magical device connected by small portals to the empire's central bank. It allows you to convert coins between denominations, and doesn't even charge interest! That's generous.

CE14TradingBoardBase.name: trading information board
CE14TradingBoardBase.description: Allows you to track what is selling and buying right now.

CE14TradingPortalBase.name: trade cabinet
CE14TradingPortalBase.description: A dimensional closet connected to a similar closet elsewhere. Not capable of moving living creatures, but great for trading at a distance.

CE14BaseEssenceNode.name: essence node
CE14BaseEssenceNode.description: A natural accumulation of magical essence.

CE14CrateDirtPitGrave.name: dirt pit
CE14CrateDirtPitGrave.description: There's something buried here... or someone...

CE14WallStone.name: rock
CE14WallStone.description: A solid stone natural wall. It has a cave-like coldness to it.

CE14WallStoneIndestructable.name: dense rock
CE14WallStoneIndestructable.description: An extremely durable stone. Your tools don't seem to be enough to break through it.

CE14WallDirt.name: earth wall
CE14WallDirt.description: A tall pile of dirt. Can a house be built from it?

CE14WallSnow.name: snow wall
CE14WallSnow.description: A tall pile of snow. Can a house be built from it?

CE14WallDimensit.name: dimensit wall
CE14WallDimensit.description: The solid form of the interdimensional continuum.

CE14WallStoneCopperOre.description: A solid stone natural wall. You can see the sharp flecks of copper in it.

CE14WallStoneIronOre.description: A solid stone natural wall. You can see the sharp flecks of iron in it.

CE14WallStoneGoldOre.description: A solid stone natural wall. You see the tantalizing particles of gold in it.

CE14WallStoneMithrilOre.description: A solid stone natural wall. You see the tantalizing particles of mithril in it.

CE14BaseWall.name: wall
CE14BaseWall.description: Sturdy enough to cover you from threats or cold winds.

CE14BaseWallFrame.description: This wall is now in an indeterminate state between existence and non-existence.

CE14WindowDirectional.name: directional window
CE14WindowDirectional.description: Don't smudge up the glass down there.

CE14WindowStoneBrick.name: stone brick window
CE14WindowStoneBrick.description: A stone brick wall with a glass window in it.

CE14WindowMarbleBrick.name: marble brick window
CE14WindowMarbleBrick.description: A stone brick wall with a glass window in it.

CE14AstralCorrosion.name: astral corrosion
CE14AstralCorrosion.description: Glowing cracks in reality. It's probably fine.

CE14FlameCreationArtificialFlame.name: artificial flame
CE14FlameCreationArtificialFlame.description: A magically created artificial flame burning directly into the air. Not a bad light source, or a weapon if you throw it in someone's face.

CE14LiquidDropWater.name: floating liquid drop
CE14LiquidDropWater.description: A clot of liquid held in the shape of a ball by magic

CE14ClothingCloakMaidArpon.name: maid's apron
CE14ClothingCloakMaidArpon.description: Cleanliness, orderliness and obedience are the main traits of a good maid.

CE14ClothingCloakAlchemist.name: alchemist's cloak
CE14ClothingCloakAlchemist.description: An expensive fabric that can withstand acid splashes - the standard for alchemist experts.

CE14ClothingCloakBlacksmithArpon.name: blacksmith's apron
CE14ClothingCloakBlacksmithArpon.description: Loose leather strips, still actually being clothing.

CE14ClothingCloakCaptainJacket.name: captain's jacket
CE14ClothingCloakCaptainJacket.description: the colors white and gold tell you that you're looking at a higher power.

CE14ClothingCloakCommandantJacket.name: commandant's cape
CE14ClothingCloakCommandantJacket.description: The colors white and gold tell you that you're looking at a higher power.

CE14ClothingCloakGuildmasterCape.name: guildmaster cape
CE14ClothingCloakGuildmasterCape.description: The colors green and gold tell you that you're looking at a higher power.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingGreenVest.name: green vest
CE14ClothingOuterClothingGreenVest.description: Stylish green vest with gold buttons.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingRedVest.name: red vest
CE14ClothingOuterClothingRedVest.description: Stylish red vest with gold flecks.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest1.name: brown vest
CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest1.description: A simple, decent leather vest. It's kind of stylish.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest2.name: brown vest with clasps
CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest2.description: The same plain brown leather vest, but with clasps.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest3.name: lightweight leather vest
CE14ClothingOuterClothingBrownVest3.description: Two flaps of leather connected by a belt from below.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingJagermeisterWai.name: jagermeister's waistcoat
CE14ClothingOuterClothingJagermeisterWai.description: Doesn't interfere with movement, looks restrained. Time to go hunting.

CE14ClothingOuterClothingMerchantWaistCo.name: merchant's waistcoat
CE14ClothingOuterClothingMerchantWaistCo.description: Stylish waistcoat made of expensive leather. A special uniform for merchants that makes customers feel like beggars.

CE14MobIceSpectre.name: icy spectre
CE14MobIceSpectre.description: The unburied soul of frozen adventurers. Her rage against the world robs her of her reason.

CE14MobMonsterMosquito.name: bloodworm mosquitoes
CE14MobMonsterMosquito.description: A bloodthirsty swarm of small mosquitoes just waiting for a soft flesh for a bloody feast.

CE14MobWatcherBase.name: watcher
CE14MobWatcherBase.description: It's like it's staring right through you.

CE14FoodTomatoes.name: tomatoes
CE14FoodTomatoes.description: A red, juicy tomato. You just want to throw it in someone's face!

CE14Snowball.name: snowball
CE14Snowball.description: A small handful of snow, handy for throwing.

CE14ManaOperationGlove.name: mana glove
CE14ManaOperationGlove.description: An unsophisticated but aesthetically pleasing blend of technology and magic crystals that allows you to operate with raw mana: siphoning it from some objects and pumping it into others.

CE14CrystalLamp.name: crystal lamp
CE14CrystalLamp.description: A device that converts energy from crystals into a source of directional light.  Convenient for traveling

CE14Torch.name: torch
CE14Torch.description: At its core, a stick burning on one side. Used to light up the area.

CE14MagicHealingStaff.name: magic healing staff
CE14MagicHealingStaff.description: A long, half-tech, half-magic stick designed to convert magical energy into healing spells.

CE14BaseShield.name: shield
CE14BaseShield.description: A wooden shield capable of withstanding multiple blows.

CE14BaseMop.name: wooden mop
CE14BaseMop.description: Mop for cleaning floors from various unpleasant liquids

CE14BaseWrench.name: wrench
CE14BaseWrench.description: A common tool for assembly and disassembly. Remember: lefty latchy, righty removey.

CE14CobwebRight1.name: cobweb
CE14CobwebRight1.description: The sticky web is surprisingly strong and unpleasant.

CE14WallmountFlagBase.name: tapestry
CE14WallmountFlagBase.description: A piece of cloth pinned to the wall.

CE14WallmauntGarlandBase.name: crystals garland
CE14WallmauntGarlandBase.description: Carefully crafted sparkling crystals tied on a string. For a festive attitude.

CE14IronDoor.name: iron door
CE14IronDoor.description: Well, if there's a solid iron door, there must be something valuable behind it.

CE14IronDoorWindowed.name: iron windowed door
CE14IronDoorWindowed.description: a solid iron door with a small window. You can look through it, of course, but it's hard to put your hand through.

CE14WoodenDoor.name: wooden door
CE14WoodenDoor.description: Not the most solid construction, but it's better than nothing.

CE14WoodenDoorWindowed.name: wooden windowed door
CE14WoodenDoorWindowed.description: Not the most solid construction, but it's better than nothing.

CE14GatherableWaterAirLily.name: air lily
CE14GatherableWaterAirLily.description: A light, delicate and airy flower. It is said that its special properties even allow it to breathe underwater...

CE14BaseBarrel.name: wooden barrel
CE14BaseBarrel.description: The simplest design for storing liquids.

CE14CraneBarrel.name: wooden crane barrel
CE14CraneBarrel.description: Large lying barrel with tap, for storing valuable liquids.

CE14CraneBarrelSmall.name: wooden small crane barrel
CE14CraneBarrelSmall.description: A small lying barrel with a tap to quickly pour liquid into mugs.

CE14BenchWood.name: wood bench
CE14BenchWood.description: A bench carved from wood, a comfortable part of the interior designed for sitting and relaxing.

CE14ChairWooden.name: wooden chair
CE14ChairWooden.description: Made of the most common planks. Simple and effective!

CE14Mannequin.name: mannequin
CE14Mannequin.description: A handy stand for clothing or armour.

CE14Safe.name: safe
CE14Safe.description: A giant iron box for storing your most precious possessions. Extremely heavy and extremely strong.

CE14TargetStake.name: target stake
CE14TargetStake.description: A wooden stand on which to fix a target for firing.

CE14TargetEffigy.name: target effigy
CE14TargetEffigy.description: The target is a scarecrow for practising close combat strikes.... or magic.

CE14WallmountLampEmpty.name: crystal wall lamp
